body: Implement bin/action.mjs dispatched on HERDR_PLUGIN_ACTION_ID per docs/herdr-integration-plan.md section 5.3. Resolve the target repo from HERDR_PLUGIN_CONTEXT_JSON (schema-validated, fail closed on malformed input). Actions: ticket-show (popup with the active ticket), gate (run adlc gate-manifest verify --json for the pane's repo, result as a notification only — token refresh is the watcher's job via its file watches; actions never write tokens themselves), prosecute (adlc prosecute in a split pane since it is long-running). All child processes use fixed argv arrays with binaries resolved from trusted PATH — never from repo config or observed state (fleet K1/A2 rule, plan section 6.2). All output rendered into terminals passes lib/sanitize.mjs. Verification: node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/action.test.mjs. allow-suppression: none
title: herdr actions: ticket-show, gate, prosecute from the pane context
